For an XBT Native SegWit watch-only test account using standard Keystone signing, Next keeps XBT-only protection on. To sign once without checking replay separation, tap “Disable XBT-only protection for this send” and read the confirmation. If the same coins exist on the SHA-256 chain, the payment could be replayed there.

Use disposable test coins. Cancel the confirmation first and verify that no signing QR appears. Choose the one-send option again, confirm, and compare the recipient, amount and fee on Keystone. No seed or password is needed on the phone. Start a new Send and use Next to check that replay protection is back on.
